title: OpenSauce
description: An open source project template and toolkit with modern tooling and best practices built in.
longDescription: OpenSauce is an open source project starter template designed to help developers ship quality software faster. It includes pre-configured linting, formatting, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and documentation templates. Built for the modern developer who wants to focus on code, not configuration.

title: AccessNode
description: Self-hosted password & account manager with AES-256 encryption, Docker-ready, and a beautiful UI.
longDescription: AccessNode is a self-hosted password and account management platform built for teams and individuals. It features AES-256 encryption, Docker-ready deployment, role-based access control, shared vaults, audit logging, and a beautiful modern UI. Perfect for organizations that need a secure, self-hosted alternative to cloud password managers.

title: Cowx Foundation
description: A modern foundation and boilerplate for building scalable web applications.
longDescription: Cowx Foundation is a modern project boilerplate and foundation library for rapidly building scalable web applications. It includes pre-configured authentication, database setup, API routing, monitoring, and deployment configurations. Built with best practices for TypeScript monorepos, it provides a consistent starting point for new projects with CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and documentation templates included out of the box.

title: CouponCore
description: A community-driven coupon and discount code sharing site with verified deals.
longDescription: CouponCore is a community-driven platform for sharing and discovering coupon codes and discount deals. Users can submit, vote, and verify coupon codes for thousands of online stores. Features include deal expiration tracking, success rate indicators, category browsing, and a browser extension for automatic coupon application at checkout. Built to help shoppers save money with confidence.

title: OpenApiVault
description: A secure vault for storing, organizing, and exploring OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
longDescription: OpenApiVault is a centralized repository for managing OpenAPI and Swagger API specifications. It provides a clean interface for storing, organizing, searching, and versioning API definitions. Features include syntax highlighting, schema validation, API documentation preview, and export to multiple formats. Ideal for teams that need a single source of truth for their API contracts.

title: CraftForge
description: Web GUI for creating, configuring, and hosting Minecraft dedicated servers.
longDescription: CraftForge is a web-based control panel for creating and managing Minecraft dedicated servers. It supports Paper, Spigot, Forge, and Fabric server types with automatic installation and updates. Features include plugin management, world backups, player management, scheduled tasks, and real-time console access. Designed for server owners who want professional-grade server management without the command line.

title: PalForge
description: Web GUI for creating and hosting PalWorld dedicated servers with one-click setup.
longDescription: PalForge is a web-based GUI for creating, configuring, and hosting PalWorld dedicated servers. It provides a clean dashboard for managing server settings, player whitelists, automatic backups, and performance monitoring. Features one-click server deployment, real-time resource monitoring, scheduled restarts, and RCON console access. Perfect for gaming communities who want full control over their PalWorld experience.

title: ToolHive
description: Free online utility tools — calculators, generators, converters, and text tools.
longDescription: ToolHive is a collection of free online utility tools including calculators, generators, converters, and text manipulation utilities. Features a clean, responsive interface with instant results. Tools include password generator, QR code generator, JSON formatter, HTML encoder, URL parser, color converter, and more. Everything runs client-side for privacy — no data leaves your browser.

title: Nexus Contacts
description: A premium cross-platform contacts manager with glassmorphism UI, 3D tilt, and confetti celebrations.
longDescription: Nexus Contacts is a premium cross-platform contacts management application featuring a stunning dark-mode-first glassmorphism UI. It includes 3D tilt card effects, particle backgrounds, confetti celebrations for milestones, and full CRUD operations. Available as a Windows executable, macOS app, Linux binary, and web version. Features include contact grouping, favorites, quick actions, and CSV import/export.

title: Pensivo
description: A modern, beautiful notes app for developers and writers with Markdown support.
longDescription: Pensivo is a modern note-taking application designed for developers and writers. It features full Markdown support with live preview, syntax highlighting for code blocks, tags and folders for organization, full-text search, and a beautiful dark-mode-first interface. Notes are stored locally and can be synced across devices. Built with a focus on speed, simplicity, and a distraction-free writing experience.

title: Website Cloner
description: Desktop GUI tool to clone any website into a local static copy with full path rewriting.
longDescription: Website Cloner is a desktop GUI application that downloads any website into a fully functional local static copy. It handles HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and fonts with intelligent path rewriting so all assets resolve locally. Features a clean Electron-based interface, configurable crawl depth, domain filtering, and one-click export. Perfect for offline browsing, archiving, and web preservation.

title: PromptsHub
description: A stunning, searchable library of 104 curated AI prompts for developers, designers, and creators.
longDescription: PromptsHub is a curated collection of 104 high-quality AI prompts organized by category. Features a beautiful searchable interface with filtering by use case, difficulty level, and AI model. Perfect for developers, designers, and creators looking to get the most out of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools. Each prompt includes usage tips and example outputs.

title: PokeCloud
description: Cloud-saved Pokemon gaming in the browser — play on any device, never lose progress.
longDescription: PokeCloud lets you play Pokemon games directly in your browser with cloud-saved progress. No downloads, no emulators — just pure Pokemon in the cloud. Supports GBA, GB, GBC, and NDS ROMs. Features secure accounts with encrypted passwords, automatic cloud saves, and optimized controls. Pick up your adventure on any device and never lose your save data again.

title: Black Tuesday MC
description: Custom Minecraft server with a community hub, custom plugins, and a real-time player dashboard.
longDescription: Black Tuesday is a custom Minecraft server featuring a community-driven survival experience with custom plugins, economy system, and a real-time web dashboard. Players can view live server status, player activity, and world stats from any browser. The server features custom enchantments, land claiming, PvP arenas, and a thriving community. Built with Paper/Spigot and a Node.js web frontend.

title: CowxCode
description: Open source, provider-agnostic AI coding agent for Windows with a polished desktop app.
longDescription: CowxCode is an open source AI coding agent that runs locally on your machine. It is provider-agnostic — supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, and more — and helps you write, edit, and understand code through a polished Electron desktop app. Features a modular architecture with a core agent engine, a black/grey/red themed UI, and a marketing site. Built for developers who want a sharp, local AI coding tool without vendor lock-in.

title: CowxWallet
description: Secure cryptocurrency wallet with multi-coin support, transaction history, and portfolio tracking.
longDescription: CowxWallet is a modern cryptocurrency wallet designed for managing digital assets securely. It supports multiple blockchain networks, tracks transaction history, and provides real-time portfolio valuations. Built with a focus on security and usability, CowxWallet makes self-custody accessible to everyone.

title: CowxCrypto
description: Live cryptocurrency market intelligence with real-time prices, signals, and portfolio tracking.
longDescription: CowxCrypto delivers real-time cryptocurrency market data including live BTC/ETH prices, market cap, trending coins, top gainers and losers, and market dominance. It features buy/sell signal detection, whale trade tracking, and a comprehensive market overview dashboard. Built for traders who need fast, reliable market intelligence without the noise.

title: CowxPass
description: Zero-knowledge password manager with AES-256 encryption, cloud sync, and autofill.
longDescription: CowxPass is a modern password manager built with security and simplicity in mind. Every password is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it leaves your device — zero-knowledge architecture means even we cannot access your data. Features include cloud sync across devices, one-click autofill, a cryptographically random password generator, secure notes, and dark web breach monitoring. No bloat, no lock-in, just serious security made simple.

title: VoidTorrent
description: Privacy-focused torrent client with built-in VPN, darknet support, and bandwidth controls.
longDescription: VoidTorrent is a modern privacy-focused torrent client designed for both casual users and power users. It features a built-in VPN kill switch, encrypted peer-to-peer connections, darknet/I2P support, and a clean cross-platform UI. Built with performance and anonymity as core principles, VoidTorrent includes automatic tracker discovery, sequential downloading, and comprehensive bandwidth controls.
